prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your New Pet Companion", "Sign in now to secure your adopted pet profile and preserve your progress."]
1: ["Select Companion Personality"]
2: ["Test Desktop Companion Visibility", "Make sure desktop display permissions are granted so your pet appears over other windows.", "Confirm Companion Visible"]
3: ["Your Desktop Companion is Live", "Interact with your pet directly on your screen or use tray controls anytime."]
4: ["Signing in with your primary email ensures your pet profile is backed up and won't reset."]
5: ["Preparing Your Companion", "You can minimize this app. We will send a desktop notification when your pet is ready!"]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Name your new desktop companion to finalize adoption.", "Companion Name"]
7: ["Choose How to Meet Your Pet", "Adopt an instantly ready companion or create a custom pet from scratch.", "Continue to Path Selection"]
8: ["Essential Desktop Pet Controls", "Review how to interact with your pet before entering your desktop.", "Pet Interactions Overview"]
9: ["Your Pet is Hatching"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal contact information (primary email).
